heroHeadline: NASA DETAILS BATTERY ENGINEERING FOR MOON'S EXTREME TEMPERATURES AS ARTEMIS SURFACE OPS ADVANCE
heroSubtitle: Oct 14: NASA has outlined its approach to engineering batteries capable of surviving the Moon's extreme temperature swings — a key challenge for sustained lunar surface operations. Also Oct 14: Artemis II crew member Christina Koch assumes new NASA leadership role.
footerNote: Data sourced from NASA.gov, OIG Reports, SpaceNews, Ars Technica, Congressional appropriations. Tier 1: NASA/ESA/Official. Tier 2: SpaceNews/Ars Technica/Reuters. Tier 3: Planetary Society/AIAA.
